label: initial-unmodified-prompt
scoring: Compare values and shape, ignore aliases, permit one global column permutation; daily/hour groups unordered; preserve ranked ordering and original numeric tolerances. Missing-data cases require explicit model refusal. No retries or result feedback to the model.

supplementalDefinitions.default-tip-rate: Use the already documented ratio-of-sums metric on positive-fare card trips; expected value from existing tips golden oracle.
supplementalDefinitions.total-including-cash-tips: Refuse: total charges exclude unrecorded cash tips.
